build_late_fusion_model: build a LateFusion multimodal model with separate encoders, a fusion module, and a head module
create_late_fusion_forward: create a forward pass through LateFusion by passing a dictionary of modality tensors
test_LateFusion_init: test the LateFusion constructor by initializing it with encoders, fusion_module, and head_module
review_LateFusion_forward: review the LateFusion forward method to understand how it encodes, fuses, and predicts from modalities
refactor_LateFusion_encoders: refactor the LateFusion encoders ModuleDict to add or remove modality-specific encoders
